caption_L1: This is a area plot named Municipal solid waste discards to landfill in California from 1995 to 2019 (in million tons). The y-axis shows Discards in million tons while the x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: Discards rose steadily from around 34000000 tons in 1995 to their peak of 42000000 tons in 2005. They then fell more steeply to around 30000000 tons in 2010, when they began to fall more gradually. In around 2012 they begin to rise again, reaching just over 40000000 tons in 2019.
